exposure: Left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) by ECG criteria
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with chronic hypertension (CHTN) who carried the pregnancy beyond 20 weeks and planned to deliver at the study institution.
finding: Left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) by ECG criteria was associated with a higher rate of superimposed preeclampsia (SIP) and lower birthweight in pregnancies with chronic hypertension (CHTN).
birth_weight: Lower in the LVH group (median 2432 g) compared to the non-LVH group (median 2870 g).
